THE SRI LANKA ARMED SERVICE LONG SERVICE MEDAL AND CLASP
IT is hereby notified that His Excellency the president has been pleased to award the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal & Clasp to the Persons specified in the schedule here to.

Air Vice Marshal Sampath Thuyacontha (Retd.) WWV, RWP and two Bars, RSP and Bar, USP, MMSc(Strat Stu - China), MSc(Def Stu) in Mgt, MSc(Def & Strat Stu), fndu (China), Psc Secretary, Ministry of Defence.
